_comment: Synthetic DNS records as the app already stores them (from Cloudflare sync), used by EXP-003 tests. Cloudflare published ranges are stubbed in the test; 104.21.0.0/16 and 172.67.0.0/16 stand in for Cloudflare space.

records._case: EXP-003 duplicate records: one points into Cloudflare space, one at a real origin -> misrouted + origin status untrusted
clean host: single record, not in Cloudflare space -> origin status trusted
single record pointing into Cloudflare space -> misrouted (Error 1000 producer)
